Hi Yeshin,

Thank you for your patience, and apologies for the delay in getting back to you on this.

After investigating, we found that Stores 3710 and 3711 haven't yet come through in your automated Location data feed, they're not currently present in our system. Since your location hierarchy is maintained through that feed, the best and most reliable way to get these two locations set up — and keep them correctly maintained going forward — is to include them in your next Location file delivery, using the same hierarchy structure as your existing Terrain Cafe / Terrain Osteria locations (Non Merchandise / Vetri Family). That way they'll flow through automatically and won't need any manual re-entry down the line.

Once that file is sent, please let us know and we'll confirm on our end that both locations have come through successfully.

Thanks again for your patience, happy to help with anything else needed to get this sorted.

Thanks & Regards,

Appriss Retail Support

Hi @Yeshin @Timothy Berry

Thank you for flagging this.

One correction first. Stores 3710 and 3711 do exist in Manage Stores. An earlier note on this ticket said they were not present in our system. That was not accurate. What is missing is their entry in the location hierarchy, which is a separate record. That is why they do not come up when you go to assign them to a user.

On inserting them manually, our position stands, and you deserve the reason behind it rather than a repeat of the request. A location added by hand sits outside the file that maintains your hierarchy. That mismatch creates problems later when data loads against those stores. Adding them at the source avoids that.

Both stores need to be in the location file URBN sends us, carrying the same hierarchy values your existing Terrain locations already use.

Please have your IT team add them, and let me know once that is done.

I will verify both locations on our end and confirm here that everything is working as expected.

Juan

RCS-28909 — Urban Outfitters: Non-Merchandise Locations Not Visible in SSO+ Location Hierarchy

Prepared: 16 September 2026 | Analyst: Diego Buelvas | Status: WORK IN PROGRESS

1. Ticket Details

Field

Value

Ticket

RCS-28909

Customer

Urban Outfitters (c044_urb)

Issue Type

Incident

Priority

Medium

Status

Work in Progress

Opened

14 September 2026

Reporter

Yeshin (ymusiano@urbn.com)

Assignee

Diego Buelvas (dbuelvas@apprissretail.com)

Jira URL

https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-28909

2. Problem Statement

Client requests manual insertion of two non-merchandise locations — Store 3710 (Terrain Cafe - Wayland) and Store 3711 (Terrain Osteria - Wayland, per ticket) — into the SSO+/Portal Location Hierarchy under Urban Outfitters > NON MERCHANDISE (NA) > VETRI FAMILY (NA), and that they be protected from being purged/overwritten by daily automated location feed updates. These locations are not visible when assigning them to user accounts in SSO+.

3. Client Profile

Field

Value

Client ID

c044_urb

Region

US

ARDM Version

V2 (snowtimeV2)

Snowflake Schema

ARDM_PRODUCTION.C044_URB / C044_URB_SNOWTIME

Active Systems

SnowTime pipeline, Secure Platform (SSO+), Incident (legacy)

4. Investigation

4.1 place.Location by StoreNumber + brand filter (Secure/Platform DB)

FAIL. 0 rows returned.

4.2 place.Location by StoreNumber only, no filter

FAIL. 0 rows — confirms absence, rules out a filter/formatting mismatch.

4.3 incident.Store (Platform DB)

FAIL. 0 rows for the two stores; a later COUNT(*) returned only 1 row total for this tenant — table not populated, not the real store source for this client.

4.4 Legacy Incident database — Store/LPUser

POINT OF FAILURE FOUND (positive match, wrong system). 2 active rows found (Inactive=0), District/Region/Division = 560-VETRI FAMILY (NA) — confirms these are two independent systems: legacy Incident has the stores, Platform/Secure (SSO+) does not.

4.5 place.Location sibling lookup (LocationID=3709)

PASS. Confirmed the join key is LocationID = numeric store number (StoreNumber column is NULL for this client, a StoreNumber='3709' lookup returned 0 rows). Returned full hierarchy template: URB/Urban Outfitters → 100099/NON MERCHANDISE (NA) → 100099/NON MERCHANDISE (NA) → 100056/VETRI FAMILY (NA) → NA560/VETRI FAMILY (NA).

4.6 REFERENCE_LOCATION schema + sibling row (Snowflake, MCP snowflake-us)

PASS. Confirmed place.Location is fed from Snowflake's REFERENCE_LOCATION via PLACE_SPOTLIGHTSEARCHLOCATIONFEED — an incremental watermark-based upsert that never deletes rows (ShouldRemove always FALSE). A manual insert will not be purged by subsequent feed syncs.

4.7 Code review — ManageStores.aspx.vb + MigrateToLocationFromStore

FINDING. "Manage Stores" (legacy Incident) and "Location Hierarchies" (Platform/SSO+) are independent, unsynced systems. A bridging procedure (incident.MigrateToLocationFromStore) exists but requires incident.Store to be populated — which it is not for this tenant (see 4.3). Not usable here.

5. Root Cause Statement

Field

Detail

What broke

Stores 3710/3711 (non-merchandise event/cafe sites) are invisible in Secure/Platform's Location Hierarchy (SSO+) and cannot be assigned to user accounts

Why

These sites are structurally excluded from Urban Outfitters' automated POS location feed (non-transactional) → never populate Snowflake's REFERENCE_LOCATION → never sync to place.Location

Scope

2 locations, Urban Outfitters (c044_urb), VETRI FAMILY (NA) hierarchy branch

Business impact

Store staff cannot get SSO+ access to these active, open locations — blocks incident logging

Evidence

0 rows in place.Location for these 2 locations (verified twice); 2 confirmed active rows in the separate legacy Incident system; sibling LocationID 3709 confirms expected hierarchy shape; PLACE_SPOTLIGHTSEARCHLOCATIONFEED source confirms upsert-only (no-purge) sync

6. Additional Findings

  • Internal note (Ryan Barlow, 2026-09-15) recommended requiring the client to add these via their automated feed. Technically consistent with root cause, but the ticket description states these sites are excluded from the standard feed by design, and 2023 precedent (RCS-8044/DO-514, same client/hierarchy) shows this exact category of site (a restaurant, store 3701) was permanently absent from the feed. A feed-only fix may leave the client blocked indefinitely.

  • Store 3711's name per ticket ("Terrain Osteria - Wayland") does not match the confirmed legacy Incident system name ("Terrain Events - Wayland") — needs confirmation before the insert.

7. Recommended Fix

Option A — Manual INSERT into REFERENCE_LOCATION (Recommended)

Insert the two locations directly into ARDM_PRODUCTION.C044_URB.REFERENCE_LOCATION (Snowflake), copying hierarchy structure from sibling LocationID 3709 and confirmed data from the legacy Incident Store table. Tag FILENAME='MANUAL-RCS-28909' for traceability/reversibility. Upsert-only sync means no purge risk; if the client's feed ever delivers these locations, the next build will correctly update the row. Low risk, fully reversible via a DELETE on the FILENAME marker. Confirm Store 3711's real name (Events vs Osteria) before running.

Ready-to-run statement (Snowflake, MCP snowflake-us or equivalent access):

INSERT INTO ARDM_PRODUCTION.C044_URB.REFERENCE_LOCATION (\n    LOCATIONID, LOCATIONHIERARCHY1, LOCATIONHIERARCHY1DESCRIPTION,\n    LOCATIONHIERARCHY2, LOCATIONHIERARCHY2DESCRIPTION,\n    LOCATIONHIERARCHY3, LOCATIONHIERARCHY3DESCRIPTION,\n    LOCATIONHIERARCHY4, LOCATIONHIERARCHY4DESCRIPTION,\n    LOCATIONHIERARCHY5, LOCATIONHIERARCHY5DESCRIPTION,\n    LOCATIONHIERARCHY6, LOCATIONHIERARCHY6DESCRIPTION,\n    LOCATIONTYPE, BRAND, LOCATIONNAME,\n    ADDRESS1, CITY, STATE, POSTCODE, COUNTRY, CURRENCYCODE,\n    INSERTEDDATETIME, UPDATEDDATETIME, FILENAME\n)\nVALUES\n(3710, 'URB', 'Urban Outfitters', '100099', 'NON MERCHANDISE (NA)', '100099', 'NON MERCHANDISE (NA)',\n '100056', 'VETRI FAMILY (NA)', 'NA560', 'VETRI FAMILY (NA)', 'NA560', 'VETRI FAMILY (NA)',\n 'RS - Retail Store', 'NON MERCHANDISE (NA)', 'Terrain Cafe - Wayland',\n NULL, 'Wayland', 'MA', '01778', 'US', 'USD',\n CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'MANUAL-RCS-28909'),\n(3711, 'URB', 'Urban Outfitters', '100099', 'NON MERCHANDISE (NA)', '100099', 'NON MERCHANDISE (NA)',\n '100056', 'VETRI FAMILY (NA)', 'NA560', 'VETRI FAMILY (NA)', 'NA560', 'VETRI FAMILY (NA)',\n 'RS - Retail Store', 'NON MERCHANDISE (NA)', 'Terrain Events - Wayland',\n NULL, 'Wayland', 'MA', '01778', 'US', 'USD',\n CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'MANUAL-RCS-28909');

Rollback, if ever needed:

DELETE FROM ARDM_PRODUCTION.C044_URB.REFERENCE_LOCATION\nWHERE LOCATIONID IN (3710, 3711) AND FILENAME = 'MANUAL-RCS-28909';

Option B — Escalate to client's automated feed

Ask client to add these two non-merchandise sites to their location feed export, mirroring existing Terrain Cafe/Osteria sites' hierarchy. Lower long-term operational cost but leaves client blocked meanwhile; 2023 precedent suggests this category of site may never make it into the feed.

8. Open Questions

  • Confirm correct name for Store 3711 ("Terrain Osteria - Wayland" per ticket vs "Terrain Events - Wayland" per legacy Incident system) before running the INSERT.

  • Confirm execution owner: run directly via Snowflake MCP, or hand off to Engineering/DataOps.

  • Response to Ryan Barlow's internal note recommending the feed-only path — needs alignment before closing.

9. Queries Run

1 — place.Location (Platform DB), StoreNumber + brand filter

SELECT LocationID, StoreNumber, LocationName, Brand,\n       LocationHierarchy1, LocationHierarchy1Description,\n       LocationHierarchy2, LocationHierarchy2Description,\n       LocationHierarchy3, LocationHierarchy3Description\nFROM place.Location\nWHERE StoreNumber IN ('3710', '3711')\n  AND (Brand LIKE '%Urban%' OR LocationHierarchy1Description LIKE '%Urban%');

Result: 0 rows.

2 — place.Location (Platform DB), StoreNumber only

SELECT LocationID, StoreNumber, LocationName, Brand,\n       LocationHierarchy1, LocationHierarchy1Description,\n       LocationHierarchy2, LocationHierarchy2Description,\n       LocationHierarchy3, LocationHierarchy3Description\nFROM place.Location\nWHERE StoreNumber IN ('3710', '3711');

Result: 0 rows.

3 — incident.Store (Platform DB)

SELECT StoreIdent, StoreNo, StoreName, District, Region, Division, WebAssignTo, Inactive\nFROM incident.Store\nWHERE StoreNo IN ('3710', '3711');

Result: 0 rows.

4 — Store/LPUser (legacy Incident DB), first attempt

SELECT Store.StoreIdent, StoreNo, Division, Region, District, Market, StoreName,\n       Address1, City, State, Zip, Country, PhoneNo,\n       LPUser.FirstName + ' ' + LPUser.LastName AS WebAssignTo, Store.Inactive\nFROM Store\nLEFT JOIN LPUser ON Store.WebAssignTo = LPUser.UserID\nWHERE Store.StoreNo IN ('3710', '3711');

Result: Error — Msg 207, Level 16, State 1, Line 1: Invalid column name 'Market'.
